social_circle.name: Tommy Rubel

demographics.occupation: maintenance worker in shipyard-related industrial work
demographics.education: high school graduate with practical on-the-job maintenance training

background.how_they_met: They met locally on the Mississippi Gulf Coast when Kailea was in her twenties and later married.
background.why_close: They have been married about 27 years, raised two children together, rebuilt routines after Katrina, and share the daily household budget, repairs, family meals, and storm preparation.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, practical texts with few extra words. He is more likely to send logistics like pay, truck, weather, or grocery needs than long emotional messages.

recent_text_topics: Friday paycheck timing, bill payments, truck gas, and whether a repair can wait.
What to pick up after work: groceries, medicine, batteries, or supplies for storm season.
Checking on his back strain and reminding him to rest after maintenance shifts.
Coordinating when Caleb, Marissa, or Eli are coming for Sunday lunch.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Kailea is married to Tommy Rubel, that he works maintenance around the shipyard, and that he is quieter but steady. Q11 says they live together full time. Q17 and Q55 say Kailea manages the household budget when Tommy's weekly pay arrives. Q35 notes Tommy has back strain from work.

social_circle.name: Marissa Whitaker

demographics.education: high school graduate with some community college coursework

background.how_they_met: Marissa is Kailea and Tommy's daughter.
background.why_close: They remain emotionally close even though Marissa has her own household. Kailea helps with childcare when needed, hears about Eli's preschool life, and uses food, listening, and practical support to care for her.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm and conversational, with frequent updates about Eli, childcare, appointments, and family plans. She is more emotionally direct than Tommy or Caleb.

shared_activities: planning visits between Ocean Springs and Moss Point
recent_text_topics: Eli's preschool snack day, picture day, and weekend overnight plans.
Childcare costs, work conflicts, and whether Kailea can help with Eli for an appointment.
Planning family meals, especially when Tommy grills or Kailea bakes.
Race and school conversations, since Marissa is more sensitive to raising a child around diverse classmates.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Marissa as Kailea's 27-year-old married daughter living in Ocean Springs with four-year-old Eli. Q19 says Kailea helps with Eli occasionally and hears about snack day and picture day. Q30 says Marissa is more sensitive to race issues, especially raising a child around diverse classmates. Q46 says Marissa opens up most easily and worries about childcare costs.

social_circle.name: Caleb Rubel

background.how_they_met: Caleb is Kailea and Tommy's younger adult child.
background.why_close: He is still local, visits most Sundays, sometimes stays overnight, and depends on Kailea's food, listening, and practical mothering while he works toward steadier adult footing.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, casual texts, often about food, shifts, laundry, or whether he can stop by. Likely uses abbreviations and answers late after work.

recent_text_topics: Whether he is coming by after a warehouse shift or staying overnight if work runs late.
Checking what leftovers are available after Sunday lunch.
Taste-testing Kailea's bakery batches, especially sweet recipes.
Work hours, steady shifts, and worries about income.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Caleb is 22, works warehouse shifts, and comes by most Sundays. Q11 and Q13 say he may stay over occasionally but does not live there. Q18 says Caleb tastes Kailea's bakery test batches and will call anything good if it has sugar. Q46 says Caleb worries about steady hours and mostly avoids politics.

social_circle.name: Renee Bosarge

background.how_they_met: Renee is Kailea's older sister; they grew up together in Moss Point with both parents and, at times, their grandmother.
background.why_close: They share family history, caregiving responsibility for their mother Darlene, church and family events, and a blunt but loyal sisterly rhythm.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Direct and opinionated. She texts in practical bursts about Mama, timing, errands, and family obligations, and may use punctuation for emphasis rather than emojis.

recent_text_topics: Which sister is taking Darlene to appointments or picking up groceries.
Medication sorting, arthritis flare-ups, and whether Darlene is driving too much.
Food timing for Sunday lunch or family gatherings.
Fussing over money decisions, promises to cousins, and holiday planning.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Kailea has an older sister, Renee, in Gautier, that they are close, talk a few times a week by phone, and fuss over food timing, money decisions for Mama, and cousin obligations. Q35 says Renee splits some errands for their mother, though Kailea does more scheduling. Q99 says Renee lived with Kailea when they were growing up.

social_circle.name: Linda Broussard

demographics.education: high school graduate with classroom aide training

background.how_they_met: Linda and Kailea met through their Baptist church choir, where Linda sings alto beside Kailea.
background.why_close: They share church life, choir, walking, prayer requests, recipes, and emotional trust. Linda is the friend Kailea would call first in a non-family emergency.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Responsive and reassuring. Uses full sentences, occasional heart or prayer-hand emojis, and checks in when she senses Kailea is overloaded.

shared_activities: talking through race and community issues
recent_text_topics: Prayer requests, choir practice, and who needs food after surgery or a funeral.
Volunteer gaps for church suppers, potlucks, and local events.
Kailea's GED stress, bakery testing, and whether she is taking on too much.
Walking plans and health goals, especially cutting back sweets and keeping knees from flaring.
Careful conversations about race, policing, and who gets heard in meetings.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Linda sings alto beside Kailea in choir and is one of her closest friends; Kailea would call Linda first in a non-family emergency because she answers and stays calm. Q38 says Kailea calls Linda when stressed. Q44 describes Linda coming over with tea and helping sort a volunteer list during an emotionally difficult night. Q29 says Kailea talks most openly with Linda about race and policing.
